The pump discharge issue may be related (cooling system), but brake temperature at 134 °C and normal oil pressure (359.9 kPa) suggest the tyre signal is the immediate outlier.

**Recommended action:** Dispatch a tyre inspection crew to HT-11 *today* to check pressures, tread wear and sidewall condition; verify the cooling pump repair (notification 10009165) resolved the low-pressure fault, since elevated tyre temps may stem from under-inflation or brake drag.
